title: Google hires former Gmail lead to be Chrome’s new VP of Product
summary: Google has hired Jacob Bank as VP of Product for Chrome. In 2015, Google acquired his Timeful smart calendar assistant, with some of those features integrated into Google Calendar and Gmail.
